bug_title: Selected task cannot be removed or moved to Completed Tasks
description: When a user selects a task from the Added Tasks list and clicks the Remove button, the selected task should be removed from Added Tasks and moved to Completed Tasks. In the buggy version, the task is not correctly submitted to the /removetask endpoint because the Remove controls are associated with the wrong form.
expected_behavior: Selecting a task and clicking Remove should send a POST request to /removetask, remove the selected task from Added Tasks, and add it to Completed Tasks.
actual_behavior: The selected task cannot be correctly removed and moved to Completed Tasks in the buggy version.
